title: Precut Cheesecloth, 15 x 15'' 4 Pack, Grade 100, Ultra Fine for Straining & Cooking, 100% Unbleached Cotton Cheese Cloth for Making Cheese
description:
About this item
Grade 100 Cheesecloth - Tighter weave cheesecloth can catch almost all impurities without leaking, performs far more better than grade 90 & 50, easier to strain the cheese and make the nut milk or yogurt more smoother.
No Impurities Left - Impurities will stay between two layers cheese cloth and hard to get them off. Use single layer cheesecloth, you will not have such problems and the straining effect is the same.
Reinforced Stitching - At the edge of the cheese cloth we have stitched to prevent shedding. So you can rest assured to use the cheesecloth without worrying about the thread or other debris falling into the food.
Wash Easily and Reusable - High quality cheesecloth makes it not easily rip or tear, you can wash the cheese cloth with soap and water or use washine machine and air dry, so you can reuse it.
Multi-purpose - Not only is the cheesecloth used to make cheese and yogurt, but also can be used to wrap spices, make wine, squeeze juice without seeds. Meanwhile, taking advantage of this cloth to create some handmade works, such as Halloween ghost dolls.

I absolutely love this cheesecloth, especially for making my homemade ginger shots! I usually juice fresh ginger, lemon, and sometimes turmeric, and this cheesecloth works perfectly for straining out all the fibrous pulp, leaving me with smooth, concentrated juice.

The fine weave ensures I get every drop of juice while keeping the fibers and pulp behind, which is especially important when making ginger shots because you want a clean, strong shot of juice without any bits. I use it every time I make ginger shots now—it’s a total game-changer.

The cheesecloth is durable and easy to clean, and I’ve found it’s also great for other uses like straining nut milks and even making homemade cheese.
